jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.
As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.
When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you’ll collaborate on some of the world’s toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

Summary

The Sr. Software Engineer will be responsible for analysis, design, development, debugging, and modification of embedded control software for electronics applications such as controllers, PFC-based 3-phase Active Rectifiers, Motor Control, DC-DC Convertors and AC Drives for harsh and hazardous environments for commercial aerospace products. You will take ownership and/or support technical engineering teams and projects related to W&W System Components. Using sound engineering principles, this engineer will interface with cross-functional groups (internal and external) to ensure robust, airworthy designs are attained which meet budget, schedule, and internal requirements and goals. This leadership position will be responsible for participating in and leading improvement activities at a group and/or company level

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Design and implement advanced control algorithms for power electronic applications
Develop control system software requirements to write embedded code for 3-phase Active Rectifier, Motor Control electronics
Contributes to system design and independently develops subsystem designs that meet the requirements. Considers tradeoffs between requirements, cost and reliability in the choice of a design approach
Test/debug power electronics controllers, Source and assembly level debugging
Optimize software performance by working with control system engineers
Work with suppliers to review control software design.
Lead or support software design review activities. Interface with vendors, customers and other departments on technical issues
Independently owns, or leads a team for small/medium size software development.
Reviews, checks and approves work done by peers and lower level engineers.
Provides guidance and training to lower level engineers.
Assesses standard work and support or lead improvement projects.
Understands how various groups (engineering, industrialization, operations) work together and is able to navigate through the company.
Analyze customer requirements and validate them by analysis/modeling/prototyping or based on existing product performance
Create software requirements specification and hardware/software interface control documents
Create verification plan for validating product compliance to requirements
Able to interface independently with technical analysts to define the software design
Able to interface independently with existing and/or new suppliers and OEMs
Creates design tools to help define the product design, capture lessons learned and improve rotating equipment development process
Creates software design document that covers design analysis, notes, and specific guidelines followed
Create design verification test procedure (DVTP) and report (DVTR)
Perform product performance testing and analysis to ensure that requirements are met and generate test reports
Independently finds or creates solutions to problems requiring research, resourcefulness and creativity
Supports feasibility, development, validation, verification, and qualification testing at Monogram and at external test laboratories.
Utilizes sound technical problem solving to support ongoing projects
Follows sound engineering principles to ensure designs meet airworthiness standards, customer requirements and ZWWS internal standards
Reviews critically and presents findings and trade studies
Provides input to program and project managers
Perform RTCA/DO-178 based process tasks and generate PSAC, SDP, SVP, SCMP, SQAP, SCI, and SAS documents
Understands, follows, and promotes, ZWWS policies and procedures
Process engineering changes in the development of water and waste systems and equipment
Documents findings and trade studies

Salary Range: $120,000-$140,000/K

The actual salary offered is dependent on various factors including, but not limited to, location, the candidate’s combination of job-related knowledge, qualifications, skills, education, training, and experience  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.

At Sonos we want to create the ultimate listening experience for our customers and know that it starts by listening to each other. As part of the Sonos team, you’ll collaborate with people of all styles, skill sets, and backgrounds to realize our vision while fostering a community where everyone feels included and empowered to do the best work of their lives.

Sonos is a sound experience company making it easier than ever for millions of listeners around the world to play more, hear more, and feel more. We’re seeking talented students to join Sonos’s Internship Program and explore what it means to blend creativity, technology, and sound. Our interns are an essential part of our team, bringing fresh ideas, learning from experts, and helping us push the boundaries of what’s possible. Come broaden your skills, share your input and pursue your passion with a 11 week internship experience.

Work Period:
June 7- August 20, 2027

Location & Schedule:
This is a 40-hour-per-week position with minimum 4 days per week onsite in our Seattle
office. There is no relocation or housing assistance for this position.

As a Software Engineer
, you will contribute to the foundational pieces of our system, ensuring high-quality and reliable operation. You will collaborate with a team of industry-leading innovators across various disciplines, including hardware, product management, and user experience. If you enjoy solving challenging problems and delivering high-quality products, we want to talk with you!

What You’ll Do

As a Software Engineer, you’ll work on a cross-functional team to design and build product features and capabilities. Examples include:

Building world class speaker products and solving challenges in areas involving embedded software development for multi-room audio processing, networking, security and user experience.
Working on the next generation of services and APIs for controlling the Sonos system as part of a smart, internet-connected home.
Empowering our users to listen better by making it easy to access new, relevant content.
Adding new features to the mobile applications that let our users control and listen to their audio content on their system.
Creating a semantic data layer to empower machine learning and AI to leverage data and diagnostics.
Using AI tools to automate critical software development workflows to improve developer productivity, experience, and security.

Skills And Attributes

Basic Qualifications

Currently enrolled in a College or University with a preferred field of study in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent
Demonstrated proficiency writing code with one or more of the following: Swift/Kotlin, C/C++, Java, Python
Familiarity with version control such as Git
Understanding of the software development lifecycle and continuous integration and deployment techniques
Implementing automated and self service software engineering processes

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with one or more of the following technologies:
App Development: Kotlin, Swift
Embedded Software: C/C++, Audio Processing, Networking, Security, AOSP
Data: Tableau, OpenSearch, Snowflake, DataDog and other system reliability and quality tracking tools

Experience with AWS Cloud Services
Experience with CI/CD build and release pipelines: Github Actions, Jenkins, Azure Pipelines, etc

Program Qualifications

Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program at a College or University, with expected graduation date of Winter 2027/2028 or Spring 2028/2029.
Available to participate in our internship program from June to August
Ability to work out of our Seattle office a minimum 4 days per week
Authorized to work for any US employer, both now and in the future. Sonos is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role at this time.

Your profile will be reviewed and you'll hear from us once we have an update. At Sonos we take the time to hire right and appreciate your patience.

jobs.description:
Overview

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

We are excited to announce that we are looking for a talented individual to join our team as a Configure, Price Quote (CPQ) Knowledge Engineer (KE) & Application Development Intern. In this role, the candidate will be assisting with the development and maintenance of Product Configuration applications (e.g., Logik.AI), ensuring seamless integration with our existing systems, and optimizing the configuration and pricing processes. We are seeking someone with strong technical skills, a keen eye for detail, and a passion for innovation. If you are looking for an opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, we would love to hear from you!

Knowledge Engineers (KEs) collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, R&D, Order Fulfillment, and Order Management to design ERP product structures and configurations for new product/option introductions with selectable features and pricing. KEs are responsible for automating the generation of accurate product quotes and orders for customers quickly and efficiently, improving quote and sales efficiency. KEs ensure that product configuration complexity is hidden using logical rules to display only relevant product selections and feature information in compliance with product specifications and Keysight Standards, guiding Keysight customers, sales representatives, and field engineers through product selection and configuration.

In the KE Team we also develop applied solutions for streamlining & modernizing digitized processes within Technology Order Fulfillment (TOF), replacing manual processes with innovative informatics and software solutions to increase configuration and operations productivity.

Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities:

Design new ways to optimize and improve the product quote-to-order process and experience.
Reduce new product introduction time to market through innovative product structure, configuration and related processes or solutions.
Deliver and maintain Technology Order Fulfillment (TOF) software solutions for configuration and operations which complement Keysight Enterprise Solutions.
Drive increased efficiency and productivity.
Modernize existing processes and digital assets with a focus on reducing or replacing manual work and eliminating waste.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

Pursuing a BS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent degree
Proficient with standard Microsoft Office suite (e.g., Excel, Outlook, MS Word, etc.)
Good oral and written communication skills
Experience with web application development
Experience with object-oriented programming

Desired Qualifications

Experience using Microsoft Visual Studio
Working knowledge of the Angular framework or a similar framework, such as React
Understanding of REST APIs and CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations
Experience with Atlassian tools, including Confluence, Jira, and Bitbucket
Knowledge of relational databases, SQL, or T-SQL
Ability to analyze data using applications such as Power BI, report builder, or other data visualization tools.

The level of role will be based on applicable experience, education and skills; most offers will be between the minimum and the midpoint of the salary range listed below.

CA pay range: MIN $32.03 to MAX $34.49

Note: for other locations, pay ranges will vary by region.

Relocation is available for this position.

At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. PACCAR is a Fortune 500 company established in 1905. PACCAR Inc is recognized as a global leader in the commercial vehicle, financial, and customer service fields with internationally recognized brands such as Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF trucks. PACCAR is a global technology leader in the design, manufacture and customer support of high-quality light-, medium-, and heavy-duty trucks under the Kenworth, Peterbilt and DAF nameplates. PACCAR also designs and manufactures advanced diesel engines, provides financial services and information technology, and distributes truck parts related to its principal business.

Kenworth Truck Company

Kenworth Truck Company, founded in 1923, is the manufacturer of The World’s Best® heavy and medium duty trucks. With an excellent heritage of quality, innovation and technology, Kenworth has played an essential role in the development of trucks that are more fuel efficient, productive, and economical to operate. Today, Kenworth is leading transportation innovation with the introduction of battery-electric vehicles, exploration of fuel cell electric powertrains, and autonomous driving systems. Kenworth is committed to fostering an environment of diversity, equality and inclusivity in the workplace.

Requisition Summary

The North American Materials organization is seeking a motivated Data Engineering Intern to join our IT team in Chillicothe, OH.
This internship provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience supporting supply chain operations and data-driven decision making. The intern will work with experienced team members to help develop data solutions, support reporting initiatives, and learn modern data engineering tools and technologies. This role offers valuable exposure to data warehousing, cloud technologies, analytics, and business intelligence within a global manufacturing environment.

Learn first-hand from experienced data engineers and analytics professionals.
Gain exposure to enterprise data warehousing and cloud-based technologies.
Participate in real-world projects supporting supply chain and business operations.
Develop mentoring relationships with experienced professionals.
Build technical and professional skills through hands-on project work.

Job Functions / Responsibilities

Support the development and maintenance of data warehouse and reporting solutions.
Assist with data integration and ETL/ELT processes from multiple business systems.
Help prepare, organize, and validate data used for analytics and reporting.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Analysts, and business users on data-related projects.
Assist in creating dashboards, reports, and visualizations using business intelligence tools such as Power BI and Tableau.
Support database and cloud platform activities involving technologies such as Snowflake, SQL Server, AWS, and other enterprise systems.
Participate in documenting data processes, business requirements, and technical solutions.
Contribute to process improvement initiatives through data analysis and problem solving.

Qualifications

Demonstrated interest in data engineering, analytics, data science, or information technology.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work effectively both independently and within a team environment.
Excellent communication and organizational skills.
Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn new technologies.
Experience with Microsoft Office products.

Education

Bachelor's Degree in Progress pursuing one of the following degrees: Information Systems, Computer Science, or other related programs.

Junior or senior standing preferred

Preferred Skills

Basic knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS or GCP)
Familiarity with data warehousing concepts.
Exposure to reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Familiarity with Python or other programming languages.
Understanding of data structures and data analysis concepts.
Experience with GitHub or source control tools is a plus.

Competitive salary and 401k with up to a 5% company match
Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family
Sick Leave
Flexible spending accounts (FSA) and health savings accounts (HSA)
EAP services: including wellness plans, estate planning, financial counseling, and more
Global Fortune 500 company with a wide array of growth, training, and development opportunities
Work alongside experienced goal-oriented colleagues recognized as experts in their fields

Ally Financial only succeeds when its people do - and that’s more than some cliché people put on job postings. We love this stuff! We see our people as, well, people - with interests, families, friends, dreams, and causes that are all important to them. From generous benefits to a variety of employee resource groups, we strive to build paths that encourage employees to stretch themselves professionally. We want to help you grow, develop, and learn new things. You’re constantly evolving, so shouldn’t your opportunities be, too?

Work Schedule:
Ally designates roles as (1) fully on-site, (2) hybrid, or (3) fully remote. Hybrid roles are generally expected to be in the office a certain number of days per week as indicated by your manager. Your hiring manager will discuss this role's specific work requirements with you during the hiring process. All work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need.

The Opportunity

Provides contributions in the design, coding, testing, support and debugging of new software or enhancements to existing software.

The Work Itself

Participate in agile ceremonies to scope, plan, and commit to a backlog for delivery.
Participate in DevOps principals practiced by the engineering organization.
Collaborates with other Engineers, Technical Leads, Architects, QA, Performance Testers, Scrum Masters, and Product Owners.
Uses technical knowledge, creativity and company practices and priorities to obtain solutions to complex problems.
Interfaces with senior management to provide and obtain information and to build consensus regarding project direction.
Escalate issues to senior management early, before they create significant impact to a project/release.
Review and approve all mid-level design documentation.
Ensure that detail design documentation is competed, reviewed, and approved, as required.
Conduct or participate in code review sessions to ensure quality and performance.
Participate and contribute to innovation workshops and hackathons
Support the system integration and user acceptance testing resources. Provide timely defect analysis, remediation, and reporting.
Review security testing reports/results and remediate potential vulnerabilities in a timely manner.
Serves as a mentor to lower level developers.
Interacts directly with business clients.

The Qualifications We’re Looking For

1+ years of applicable experience and a bachelor’s degree in technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of experience and education.
Knowledge of all phases of software development including design, coding, testing, debugging, implementation, and support
Experience writing and reviewing software design specifications in an object-oriented development environment

Familiarity with web service interaction (JSON/XML)

Strong Problem-Solving and Analytical Skills
Effective communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences
Strong written and verbal communications skills
Understanding and ability to work under varying project delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall)

Experience translating product requirements into design specifications.
Debugging and problem-solving skills.
Ensure quality software is delivered with minimal defects and no go live critical issues. Knowledgeable of unit and automation testing tools.
Ability to thoroughly understand the business issues surrounding each project
Ability to respond directly to questions from business clients
Ability to be a technical authority and work with other team members
Knowledge of standard change management tools and processes
Ability to work in a team environment
Hands on technical experience

Minimum Qualifications

1+ years of experience
High school Diploma or GED equivalent

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.
Who are we:
Have an interest in making an impact for millions of consumers? Do you thrive in a cross-collaborative environment? Are you ready to take on your next career challenge? If you want to pursue your professional goals as you help grow an innovative real estate tech company, this work is for you!

We’re offering a dynamic opportunity for an Associate
Software Engineer to join our Owners & Sellers team. In this role, You will act as a foundational technical engineer running mission-critical platforms that directly drive revenue, while taking charge of initiatives that improve the consumer experience and drive core business outcomes. Leverage the latest technologies, including Typescript, React, Node.js, NextJS, GraphQL, AWS, AI tools, and more, to accelerate your professional growth and achieve new heights in your career.

Top Reasons to Apply:
Hands-On Cloud & DevOps Ownership
You’ll own the infrastructure, not just the code. You will design AWS data pipelines and automate the toolchain (using Lambda, ECS, and CloudFormation) to enable instant service provisioning and zero-friction deployments.
AI-Driven Engineering Culture
The team actively rewards engineers who leverage AI tools as a performance multiplier. You’ll be encouraged to use AI to write better code faster and accelerate development in a forward-thinking environment.

What you’ll do:
●    Develop and Maintain: Own systems and evolutions for key parts of the Owners & Sellers platform, defining clear boundaries, contracts, and data models between services. Participate in and lead architectural discussions, contributing to technical design documents and implementation proposals.
●     Full-Stack Excellence: Maintain and improve the stability, readability, and scalability of the codebase, ensuring best practices across backend services and frontend architecture using React and Next.js.
●    Optimize Performance & Reliability: Drive performance improvements and optimize Core Web Vitals (such as INP metrics) across our pages. Lead operational excellence by ensuring services meet SLAs, influencing incident response, and continuously reducing incident volume and MTTR.
●    Leverage Cutting-Edge Tooling: Utilize AI coding assistants and LLMs proficiently to accelerate development velocity, generate boilerplate, and troubleshoot complex debugging scenarios, while exercising critical judgment to verify outputs for security and accuracy.

What You’ll Bring:
●    Software development experience, including internships, academic projects, or relevant professional experience. including time in large-scale, distributed systems 
●    Full-stack proficiency: Experience in frontend web development with a strong focus on Typescript, React js and Apollo GraphQL combined with deep proficiency in backend languages like Node js and GraphQL.
●    AI Tooling Mastery: Proven proficiency using modern AI-assisted SDLC environments and agents (e.g., Claude/Cursor/GitHub Copilot, - based engineering agents) and drive AI adoption at scale
●   Cloud & Infrastructure Expertise: Experience designing and operating cloud-native services on AWS (EKS, containers like Docker, managed databases) with modern CI/CD orchestration (e.g., CircleCI, ArgoCD, Kubernetes).
●    Systems Design: Strong grounding in system design, data modeling, API design, responsive design principles, and CSS technologies like PandaCSS/CSS3.
●    Observability & Data-Driven Mindset: Comfort working with observability tooling (metrics, logs, traces like NewRelic and Splunk) and using data to debug, optimize, and harden production systems.
●    Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering/related field or equivalent professional experience.
How We Work:
We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. Our employees work three days in our Austin headquarters where they have the opportunity to collaborate in-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together.
How We Reward You:
Realtor.com® is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits include:
●        Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage.

●        Free snacks and refreshments in each office location.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Nuro believes self-driving vehicles are the most immediate and profound opportunity for AI to drive positive change in the physical world. Safer streets, more time for what matters, and easier access to the world around us, that’s why we’re building a universal autonomy platform: self-driving for all roads and all rides.

Founded in 2016, Nuro is a physical AI company developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology for a wide range of vehicles, use cases, and markets. Powered by the Nuro Driver™, our universal autonomy platform enables the global mobility ecosystem to deploy autonomy at scale, from robotaxis and logistics fleets to personal vehicles.

With years of real-world deployment experience and a flexible, partner-led business model, Nuro is working toward a future where millions of autonomous vehicles powered by our technology help make everyday life safer, easier, and more connected.

Nuro has raised over $2B in capital from Uber, NVIDIA, Google, Softbank, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, and other leading investors.

About The Role

Nuro operates real self-driving vehicles on public roads today — not a research platform, not ADAS. The Embedded Software Engineering team builds the software for the safety-critical embedded controllers that connect the Nuro Driver™ to the vehicle: the devices that command steering, braking, and propulsion, alongside other vehicle actuators, distribute and monitor power, monitor vehicle motion, and bring the vehicle to a safe state when something goes wrong.

As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will work across the full stack of multicore automotive microcontrollers from RTOS, drivers, and scheduler up through middleware and application components that talk to the vehicle, and help extend that stack as our hardware evolves. You will bring the Nuro Driver™ up on new vehicle platforms alongside OEM and supplier engineers, and see your code drive real vehicles on public roads. We're hiring across levels, from engineers with a couple years of embedded experience to those who've shipped a production automotive launch.

About The Work

Design, implement and test embedded C software for safety-critical multicore automotive microcontrollers, spanning base software such as RTOS, device drivers, scheduling and bootloader, middleware such as inter-component messaging and end-to-end protection, and application components such as actuator interface, body controls, power management and fault management.
Integrate the Nuro Driver™ with new vehicle platforms: define and implement CAN and Ethernet interfaces with OEM ECUs, adapt actuator and body-control interfaces, and validate them on bench and in vehicle.
Take part in hands-on device and vehicle bring-up, prototyping and debugging on multiple vehicle platforms, from first power-on to autonomous driving.
Build and maintain the team's verification infrastructure: unit tests, hardware-in-the-loop benches and vehicle test procedures.
Work within an ISO 26262 development process: define software requirements from system safety requirements, then implement and verify them with full traceability.
Collaborate daily with systems, safety, hardware, controls and autonomy engineers, and with OEM and supplier partners, from definition through verification.

About You

B.S. or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field.
2+ years of industry experience developing embedded software in C, including work on a real-time operating system.
Solid computer science fundamentals: data structures, concurrency and algorithm design.
Working knowledge of microcontroller internals and peripherals, with depth in at least one of device driver development, CAN or automotive Ethernet, bootloaders and software update, embedded security, or vehicle-level integration and test.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, clear written and spoken communication, and a track record of working well with engineers from other disciplines.
Comfortable at the bench with debug probes, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and CAN tools. You enjoy finding out why hardware and software disagree.

Bonus Points

3+ years of embedded development in the automotive or autonomous vehicle industry, including a production launch.
Hands-on functional safety experience with ISO 26262, or safety-critical development in another regulated industry such as DO-178C or IEC 62304.
Experience with Infineon AURIX TC3xx, SafeRTOS or FreeRTOS, or AUTOSAR Classic base software such as MCAL and communication stacks.
Vehicle network integration experience: DBC and ARXML, UDS diagnostics, E2E protection, time synchronization.
Knowledge of vehicle functions, vehicle dynamics or control theory.

At Nuro, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. For this position, the reasonably expected base pay range is between $145,830 and $219,000 for the level at which this job has been scoped. Your base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, equity, and a competitive benefits package.

At Nuro, we celebrate differences and are committed to a diverse workplace that fosters inclusion and psychological safety for all employees. Nuro is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and expressly prohibits any form of workplace discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

You will guide clients through complex integration and performance management strategies, leveraging your deep technical expertise in SQL, NoSQL, Cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ). While you will advise on the installation and configuration of our platform, you will also apply your hands-on engineering skills to design and implement custom Java interfaces, web service integrations, and bespoke extensions for our Fraud Analysis platform. Working alongside Data Scientists, Project Managers, and Fraud Analysts, you will translate client challenges into robust, scalable technical requirements and remain actively involved in executing those requirements when specialized development is required.

Consult with clients to define technical requirements and architectural approaches for custom integrations.
Develop high-quality, testable Java code for custom extensions and complex integrations when standard configurations do not meet specific client needs.
Diagnose complex performance and integration challenges, providing expert guidance and code-level solutions to ensure system stability.

Contribute to and advocate for engineering best practices, ensuring that custom work remains maintainable and aligned with the core product roadmap.
Mentor, coach, and inspire other team members, helping foster best practices in software development and technical consulting.
Work with Agile principles to regularly deliver quality products.
Provide Second Tier support for live clients.

3 years of work experience in Java software development;
Thread and JVM Memory Management in high-performance systems;
Client engagement experience and ability to act as a consultant to our clients;
Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written;
Experience with Zookeeper, RabbitMQ, Cassandra, Ansible, Docker, and databases (nice to have).

About Activate Care:

At Activate Care, we're on a mission to improve health equity and drive better health outcomes across the country. Our Care Link platform enables healthcare and community organizations to coordinate care for populations challenged with health-related social needs (HRSN). Path Assist is our tech-enabled community health worker program for HRSN that uses an evidence-based, structured intervention to help individuals build confidence managing their health and accessing the resources they need. Our goal is simple: increase health confidence, improve self-efficacy, and reduce inappropriate healthcare spending.

About the Role:

Our platform helps healthcare providers and community organizations coordinate care for individuals facing complex medical and social challenges. The systems we build support real-time collaboration across health records, referral networks, and community services.

As a Software Engineer at Activate Care, you will help design and build the tools that power this coordination. You will work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver high-quality software that directly supports organizations improving outcomes for vulnerable populations.

You'll contribute across the full development lifecycle—from designing solutions and writing production code to improving system quality and participating in technical discussions within your team.

Responsibilities:

Implement well-specified features with guidance from senior engineers
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code that supports system reliability and scalability
Contribute to responsive web applications and progressive web apps
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and team ceremonies
Write and maintain automated tests to ensure system reliability
Collaborate with product and design teams to deliver user-focused solutions
Document code, specifications, and workflows for clarity and reusability
Learn and apply prompt engineering, AI-assisted dev tools, and automation frameworks to accelerate productivity

Requirements

Qualifications & Skills:

Must Have:

Minimum of a High School Diploma with an equivalent of 4+ years of Software Engineering experience, or a Bachelor's Degree in a related field
3+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer, healthcare experience is preferred
Experience working effectively within Agile/Scrum teams
Advanced ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non technical stakeholders
Willingness, and ability to learn new technologies, adapt to feedback and continuously improve technical skills

Core Technical Skills

Experience building applications using Ruby on Rails, Ruby Sinatra, or Node JS /Fastify
Frontend development experience with React, Svelte and modern JavaScript
Experience building scalable responsive web applications and progressive web apps using HTML/CSS
Experience with Native web applications is a plus

Experience developing and integrating RESTful APIs and web services
Familiarity with relational or document databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or EdgeDB
Experience with background job processing systems such as ActiveJob, Sidekiq, or Resque

Productivity & AI-Enhanced Development

Experience using Cursor, MCP agents, LLMs, or Ollama
Strong understanding of prompt engineering concepts
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins or CircleCI
Familiarity with development automation and workflow optimization

Software Engineering Principles

Strong understanding of separation of concerns, code quality, and maintainable architecture
Experience designing and implementing well-tested features
Familiarity with multiple quality domains such as functionality, performance, and reliability
Experience with testing frameworks such as Cypress, MiniTest, or other automated testing approaches
Experience working with Git workflows, pull requests, and collaborative development practices

Nice to Have:

Experience maintaining Ruby on Rails applications in production environments
Experience maintaining PWA's and SPA applications
Experience working with AWS or other cloud platforms
Familiarity with containerization tools such as Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes/Helm
Knowledge of secure coding practices (OWASP, Brakeman) and handling sensitive healthcare data (HIPAA awareness)
Prior experience working on healthcare platforms or workflow automation systems

Diversity & Inclusion:

At Activate Care, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation, and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military, and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. jobs.description:
Ally and Your Career

Ally Financial only succeeds when its people do - and that’s more than some cliché people put on job postings. We love this stuff! We see our people as, well, people - with interests, families, friends, dreams, and causes that are all important to them. Our focus is on the health and safety of our teammates as well as work-life balance and diversity and inclusion. From generous benefits to a variety of employee resource groups, we strive to build paths that encourage employees to stretch themselves professionally. We want to help you grow, develop, and learn new things. You’re constantly evolving, so shouldn’t your opportunities be, too?

Work Schedule:
Ally designates roles as (1) fully on-site, (2) hybrid, or (3) fully remote. Hybrid roles are generally expected to be in the office a certain number of days per week as indicated by your manager. Your hiring manager will discuss this role's specific work requirements with you during the hiring process. All work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Software Engineer at Ally, you will design, build, test, and support software that powers critical customer and business experiences. You will own meaningful technical solutions from design through production, work independently within squad priorities, and mentor less-experienced engineers.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who balances near-term delivery with quality, security, reliability, and long-term technical health. We value the ability to solve problems, learn new technologies, and use AI development tools effectively.

At Ally, you will solve meaningful engineering problems at enterprise scale while staying close to the code. You will work across modern and established platforms, use advanced AI-assisted development tools, and help shape how our technology evolves.

The Work Itself

Design, develop, test, deploy, and support production software.
Own features and technical solutions from design through implementation and support.
Write and review code using traditional, automated, and AI-assisted development approaches.
Collaborate with Product, Architecture, SRE, Cybersecurity, Risk, and partner engineering teams.
Improve software quality, reliability, maintainability, and developer productivity.
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance.

Minimum Qualifications

The Qualifications We're Looking For

3+ years of relevant experience
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

Professional experience building and supporting production software in a complex environment.
Strong engineering fundamentals with depth in at least one programming language or technology domain.
Ability to independently drive solutions, raise risks, and seek alignment when needed.
Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.
A production mindset that considers security, reliability, observability, maintainability, and customer impact.

Core Technologies

Experience with some of the following: Python, Java, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, React Native, Spring, REST APIs, automated testing, CI/CD, Git, and AWS or Azure.

How We'll Have Your Back

Ally's compensation program offers market-competitive base pay and pay-for-performance incentives (bonuses) based on achieving personal and company goals. Our Total Rewards program includes industry-leading compensation and benefits plus additional incentives that are designed to meet your needs and those of your family so you can get the most out of your career and your life, including:

Time Away:
Program starts at 20 paid time off days in addition to 11 paid holidays and 8 hours of volunteer time off yearly (time off days are prorated based on start date and program varies based on full or part-time status and management level).

Planning for the Future:
plan for the near and long term with an industry-leading 401K retirement savings plan with matching and company contributions, student loan pay downs and 529 educational save up assistance programs, tuition reimbursement, employee stock purchase plan, and financial learning center and financial coach access.

Supporting your Health & Well-being:
flexible health and insurance options including medical, dental and vision, employee, spouse and child life insurance, short- and long-term disability, pre-tax Health Savings Account with employer contributions, Healthcare FSA, critical illness, accident & hospital indemnity insurance, and a total well-being program that helps you and your family stay on track physically, socially, emotionally, and financially.

Building a Family:
adoption, surrogacy and fertility assistance as well as paid parental and caregiver leave, Dependent Day Care FSA back-up child and adult/elder care days and childcare discounts.

Work-Life Integration:

jobs.description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About The Team

The Growth Engineering team at Mixpanel is responsible for increasing user activation and driving self-serve revenue. We work closely with Product, Design, and Marketing to grow the funnel of customers landing on our platform, implementing Mixpanel, and seeing value fast. We move fast, experiment constantly, and measure everything.

Within growth: this role is for the Top of Funnel Pod, a small crew specifically targeting user acquisition and activation. Some examples of what we’ve shipped lately:

Agentic onboarding
Experiment: Home page new feature product setup nudges
Experiment: MCP connection

About The Role

As a Software Engineer on the Growth team, you will build and optimize the experiences that drive user acquisition, activation, and conversion at Mixpanel. A key focus of this role is web experimentation — you'll design, implement, and analyze experiments across our product onboarding flows and other surface areas to improve key growth metrics. You'll work across the full stack, from frontend UI changes to backend data pipelines, and collaborate with Product and Design to turn experiment insights into product improvements. This is a high-impact role where your work directly influences Mixpanel's top-of-funnel growth and self-serve revenue.

Responsibilities

Design, build, and analyze experiments across Mixpanel's product and onboarding flows to optimize acquisition and activation metrics
Partner with Product and Design to identify high-impact experiment hypotheses grounded in data and user research
Instrument tracking and build dashboards (in Mixpanel!) to measure experiment outcomes and inform iteration
Build and improve onboarding experiences that drive down time to value, and increase activation rates for new Mixpanel users
Participate in team on-call rotation to improve our systems and keep them healthy

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

At least 2 years of full-stack software engineering experience
Excellent debugging and technical investigation skills
Comfort using modern AI coding tools
Experience running growth experimentation
Strong technical communication, ideally with experience collaborating in an asynchronous remote environment
Ability to move fast and iterate — you take ownership of problems and focus on delivering value to users
A data-driven mindset

Bonus Points For

Interest in leveraging AI/GenAI to accelerate experimentation workflows
Prior experience on a growth engineering team or in a growth-focused role
React / TypeScript experience
Django / Python experience
Experience with experimentation platforms (e.g. Mixpanel, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly, Statsig, or similar)

Benefits And Perks

Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care
Mental Wellness Benefit
Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays
Enhanced Parental Leave
Volunteer Time Off
Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break
please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.
Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.
One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.
Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.
Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.
Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

Job Description

Join a dynamic team focused on automating and streamlining the Post-Test Analysis (PTA) pipeline for the THAAD Ground Station Team. This role aims to reduce manual analyst overhead, accelerate test validation, and generate key qualification deliverables.

Responsibilities

Architect and implement core automated log parsing, data reduction models, tool integrations, and reporting engines.
Develop, test, and maintain automated scripts, unit tests, and continuous build processes.
Engage in Agile Integration & Execution, managing features via prioritized backlogs with bi-monthly progress meetings and live working code demos.
Develop modular Python libraries and interactive Jupyter Notebook environments for hands-off test-step validation, log ingestion, parsing, error extraction, event sequencing, and time-series log alignment.
Leverage core Python data science libraries to process raw log streams, execute data reduction, and align sensor and target trajectory data in time and space.
Evaluate and integrate the Python-based SLAP tool for visual log parsing, timeline inspection, and diagnostic plotting.
Automate the compilation of telemetry, performance metrics, plots, and 3D mission reconstruction animations into standardized reports.
Utilize Test-Driven Development with unit/integration test suites, Docker containerization, and Git repository management.

Advanced Python programming and modular library development.
Expertise in the Core Python Data Science Stack (pandas, numpy, scipy, scikit-learn) for high-dimensional data reduction and spatio-temporal telemetry alignment.
Integration of graphical utilities such as SLAP, Plotly, Dash, and Matplotlib.
Design and integration of relational (SQL) and document-oriented (NoSQL) databases.
Experience with automated report generation and 3D mission reconstruction visualization tools.
Proficiency in constructing interactive Jupyter Notebook workflows.
Version control and DevOps practices using Git and Docker containerization.
Experience with Test-Driven Development, including writing unit and integration testing suites.
Strong technical writing skills to support customer deliverables.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Experience in creating custom dashboards and visual utilities.
Familiarity with automated data reduction and input streamlining processes.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

jobs.description:
About Fab2

The fab2 team can build anything. We design all the hardware and software needed to make chips and we make the fabs, tools, and components ourselves.

We're looking for exceptional, hands-on people who can iterate to the limits of what's possible.

fab2 was founded by Sam Zeloof and Jim Keller. Sam is best known for making chips in his garage, and Jim has been a leader in the semiconductor industry for the past 40 years.

About The Team

The tool software group builds Linux control software and microcontroller firmware for fab2’s in-house semiconductor manufacturing equipment. This includes software for sensing, real-time microcontroller firmware, closed loop controls, sequencing, recipe execution, interlocks, operator user interfaces, and diagnostics.

About The Role

You will build computer vision software for lithography and metrology on semiconductor manufacturing equipment. This includes modeling optical systems and developing nanometer-scale alignment (fiducials, calibration methods) through iteration on real hardware. You will also develop vision systems for wafer-handling and process automation equipment. Additionally, you will work on post-lithography metrology, including defect detection and optical proximity correction (OPC) modeling.

You will work closely with full-stack, mechanical, electrical, optical, and process engineers on cross-functional problems.

We are open to a range of experience levels, from early-career to experienced engineers. The most important attribute is a strong mathematical and programming background and the ability to experiment and learn new things.

Responsibilities

Develop classical computer vision algorithms for inspection, measurement/metrology, alignment, positioning, defect detection, and camera calibration.
Build systems that extract reliable measurements and process information from images, including dimensions, feature boundaries, and manufacturing variation.
Develop image registration, camera calibration, and pose estimation capabilities for precision equipment and optical systems.
Apply spatial-domain and frequency-domain image processing techniques to solve scientific and industrial vision problems.
Integrate computer vision systems with cameras, motion systems, robotics, and other electromechanical equipment.
Turn experimental approaches into reliable production software, including testing, validation, performance optimization, and failure handling.
Partner with software, mechanical, electrical, optical, and process engineers to develop new manufacturing and metrology tools.

Required Experience

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong foundation in classical computer vision and image processing.
Experience with techniques such as image registration, feature detection, camera calibration, geometric transformations, pose estimation, or image filtering.
Experience analyzing images in both the spatial and frequency domains.
Understanding of how optics, illumination, sensors, noise, and resolution affect image quality and computer vision performance.
Experience developing computer vision software using Python, C++, OpenCV, or similar tools.
Ability to design experiments, compare technical approaches, and characterize algorithm accuracy and repeatability.
Ability to take computer vision work beyond a prototype and deploy it as maintainable, reliable software.

Nice-to-have

Experience with semiconductor equipment, metrology, manufacturing inspection, microscopy, scientific instrumentation, or industrial automation.
Experience characterizing optical systems using metrics such as resolution, MTF, PSF, etc.
An understanding of optical inaccuracies: chromatic/spherical aberrations, astigmatism, etc.
Experience with precision alignment, motion systems, robotics, or sensor fusion.
Experience working with scientific or industrial cameras.
Research experience, publications, or a strong computer vision project portfolio.

Working at fab2

We’re an early-stage hardware startup with solid funding, world-class advisors, and labs/offices in Austin, TX, Lockhart, TX, and San Francisco, CA.

jobs.description:
Description

Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainable. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

Your greatest work is ahead!

Leidos’ Defense Sensors - Sensor Research and Analysis Division is seeking a Software Developer
to join our team. The division performs radar design, hardware builds, algorithm development, software development, HWIL testing and analysis across a variety of both research and development and operational tasks.

The candidate selected for this role will primarily support the design, implementation, and optimization of real-time software powering RF seeker capabilities and signal-processing pipelines. The selected candidate will maintain a familiarity with the fielded systems our division supports, investigate cutting-edge RF seeker technologies, and develop studies which educate our customers on seeker technology advancements. These studies will consist of provisional MATLAB modeling, closed-loop simulation, and validation on radar hardware. The selected candidate will work closely with algorithm development engineers to transition prototype algorithms (such as MATLAB/Python models) into robust, maintainable, high-performance software architectures (modern C++) targeted for real-time and embedded environments. You will also participate in closed-loop simulations, HWIL integration, and system validation on radar hardware. The candidate will present progress and findings of these studies to government and prime contractor stakeholders and will collaborate with the rest of the division on radar development and testing activities.

If this sounds like the kind of environment where you can thrive, keep reading!

Leidos Defense Systems Sector
provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions. To explore and learn more, click here!

Are you ready to make an impact? Share your resume with us today!

Relevant Experience Areas

RF Seeker CONOPS – Concepts of operations and decisions to close the kill chain with an RF seeker in various use cases and environments.
RF Seeker Mode Logic – Waveform, algorithm, and guidance methods associated with distinct stages of an RF Seeker flight, and transitioning between those stages.
Signal Processing – Waveform design, matched filtering, detections processing, clutter rejection, target feature extraction
Electronic Warfare – Analysis of radio signal countermeasures and protections against countermeasures
Simulation Development – Designing architecture, resource management, interface, and feature models of radar and seeker simulations
Modeling & Analysis – Setup, test, analyze, and evaluate radar or communications algorithms in software
Software Development – Experience in high performance computing languages such as C++
Calibration – Far-field and/or near-field calibration techniques for radar systems
Tracking – Design and analysis of Kalman filters, IMMs, detection to track association varieties
Radar Resource Management – Scheduling techniques for optimized commands between radar subsystems
RF Test Equipment – Experience with RF troubleshooting equipment such as Vector Network Analyzers, oscilloscopes, and signal generators

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering or related technical field from an ABET-accredited institution plus 2+ years of experience in one or more listed experience areas, or a relevant MS degree with exposure to one or more listed experience areas.
Must have excellent math skills and/or possess and show good fundamentals in one or more of the following:
Signals and systems
Digital signal processing
Tracking algorithms
Electromagnetics

Should be able to apply one or more of the above skills to the areas of radar modeling & simulation, antenna array theory, digital signal processing, tracking, algorithm development, and field testing of sensor systems.
Experience working with MATLAB, Python, or similar scientific-based programming tools to implement math or scienced based phenomenology related to linear systems, digital signal processing, tracking, or electromagnetics is required.
Experience with developing component/subsystem/system acceptance/verification test plans and reports.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a strong technical background.
A positive, proactive attitude and enthusiasm for learning, collaborating, and tackling challenging engineering problems.
Must be a resident of the North Alabama area or willing to relocate to the Huntsville - North Alabama, AL area. This is NOT a remote or work-from-home position.
Must be a US Citizen and possess (and be able to maintain) a Final Secret Clearance or meet the eligibility to obtain (and maintain) a Secret Clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated proficiency in several of the listed experience areas
Highly organized, demonstrating the ability to work independently at times due to fast-paced and highly productive work environment
Ability to create design documentation, requirements specifications, and other technical documentation
Demonstrated experience in understanding, evaluating, and implementing published scientific literature from sources such as IEEE.
Relevant publications in listed experience areas

At Ally, you get a startup feel, with the benefits of a company that has worked out the kinks and is fulfilling its purpose. We are always evolving, and we see that as a good thing. We are seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, test, deploy, and support dealer-facing applications that power critical business interactions and digital experiences. This role will contribute to secure, scalable, and high-performing platforms across front-end, back-end, APIs, and cloud infrastructure, with a strong focus on usability, reliability, integration, maintainability, and production excellence.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will partner with product, architecture, business, and engineering teams to translate requirements into high-quality technical solutions, participate in release and production support activities, and help continuously improve dealer experience and platform stability. You will also contribute to engineering standards, perform code reviews, and support a culture of collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement.

At this time, Ally will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The Work Itself

The Work Itself

Full-Stack Engineering. Design, develop, test, and support full-stack capabilities across front-end, back-end, APIs, data, and cloud infrastructure for dealer-facing applications, with a focus on usability, performance, resiliency, security, and maintainability.
Backend Engineering. Build secure, performant REST APIs and microservices using Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript; apply sound API design, asynchronous processing, error handling, enterprise integration patterns, and relational database practices using platforms such as Postgres or Oracle.
AWS Backend Stack. Develop and support cloud-native solutions using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, S3, and CloudFront; use Terraform, IAM, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store, and CloudWatch to support secure configuration, repeatable provisioning, monitoring, alerting, and production observability.
Frontend Engineering. Build performant, responsive, and accessible dealer-facing user interfaces using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern CSS practices; integrate APIs and apply usability-focused implementation, DevOps practices, and AWS deployment patterns.
Frontend Architecture. Contribute to micro frontend architecture, module federation, reusable component design, and client/server state management using tools such as React Query, Redux, or Zustand.
Architecture, Delivery & Operations
Collaborate with architects, product partners, and cross-functional teams to define technical approaches, integration patterns, and scalable solution components that improve dealer workflows and experience.
Translate business and dealer workflow requirements into technical designs, implementation tasks, and high-quality application changes.
Support release management activities for dealer-facing applications, including deployment readiness, dependency coordination, production validation, rollback planning, and post-release support.
Identify technical risks related to scalability, security, production stability, and dealer impact, and recommend practical mitigation options.
Participate in sprint planning, technical estimation, dependency management, support prioritization, and delivery commitments with clear ownership of assigned engineering work.
Partner with product, architecture, and development team members to clarify scope, resolve dependencies, and deliver reliable solutions.
Work directly with product owners to ensure stories contain appropriate technical direction, acceptance criteria, and implementation detail.
Coordinate with Engineering and Operations teams to support environment readiness, deployment activities, and production stability.
Drive continuous improvement through code reviews, documentation, troubleshooting, knowledge sharing, and collaboration with peers.
Create and maintain high-quality deliverables that meet performance, security, testability, and maintainability expectations.
Communicate effectively with product partners, architecture, engineering peers, support teams, and leadership as needed.
Provide technical guidance to peers and help promote consistent engineering practices across the team.

Minimum Qualifications

The Qualifications You Bring

3+ years of relevant experience or equivalent combination of education and experience
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of hands-on cloud engineering experience building and operating scalable applications on AWS, with strong knowledge of serverless and distributed system patterns
Strong CI/CD and DevOps experience, including build automation, release pipelines, infrastructure as code, environment promotion, and production deployment support
Perform detailed code reviews and apply feedback to improve engineering quality across performance, security, testability, maintainability, and adherence to design standards.
Contribute to coding standards, secure development practices, testing discipline, and engineering best practices that improve reliability, supportability, and long-term maintainability of dealer-facing platforms.
Candidate must have hands-on experience with AI tooling for software engineering productivity, code generation, analysis, or automation use cases

Highly Preferred Qualifications

Team members work in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment supporting the entire software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, software development, testing, deployment, infrastructure management, and operational support. Engineers work closely with instructors, developers, and system administrators to deliver reliable, realistic training capabilities.

Unlike many software organizations where engineers are assigned to a single product or technology stack, members of the DevOps team contribute across a diverse portfolio of applications, services, and supporting infrastructure. This position is ideal for software engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, learning new technologies, and applying their skills across a diverse portfolio of software, infrastructure, and operational systems.

Team members are expected to broaden their experience across multiple areas of the software development lifecycle while developing technical expertise in one or more areas.

Design, develop, troubleshoot, and maintain software applications supporting cyber training environments.
Analyze requirements and develop technical solutions that support mission and customer needs.

NRC Health h elp s healthcare organizations deeply understand the people they serve and turning that “Human Understanding” into meaningful action. At its core, our work is about helping organizations build trust, improve engagement, and advance better outcomes.

My Time Off (MTO), our flexible paid time off program
Up to 12 weeks of paid parental and emergency leave
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
Wellness program and financial coaching
Professional growth and career development opportunities

Who we want

Do you have experience building modern cloud-native engineering platforms that enable healthcare organizations to deliver exceptional patient and employee experiences?

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, MIS, IT, Engineering, or a related field with outstanding academics, or equivalent experience and the demonstrated ability to learn
3+ years’ experience working on a professional development team
Strong software engineering experience developing production applications.
Experience administering Kubernetes clusters (Amazon EKS preferred).
Experience working with AWS cloud service such as EKS, RDS, IAM, S3, Route 53, ALB, and CloudWatch.
Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
Experience automating infrastructure, deployments, or operational workflows.
Understanding of cloud architecture, scalability, distributed systems, and modern application design.
Experience troubleshooting production systems in cloud environments.
Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and logging platforms.
Demonstrated proficiency using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar to improve software development effectiveness.

Strong problem-solving skills with an ownership mindset.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills.
Experience with test-driven development (NUnit or similar).
Familiarity with client-side JavaScript/Typescript web frameworks, such as ReactJS or EmberJS.
Strong SQL development experience
Experience working effectively with non-technical business partners to inform product and business decisions
Willingness to act as a mentor to other team members.

Experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux.
Experience with Docker and container security.
Experience implementing observability using Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms.
Experience with Linux system administration.
Experience supporting highly available production systems.
Experience in healthcare or other regulated industries.

Ever-expanding technology like IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence means that there’s more structured and unstructured data available today than ever before. As a data engineer, you know that organizing data can yield pivotal insights when it’s gathered from disparate sources. We need an experienced data engineer like you to help our clients find answers in their data to impact important missions, from fraud detection to cancer research to national intelligence.

As a data engineer at Booz Allen, you’ll help build advanced technology solutions and implement data engineering activities on some of the most mission-driven projects in the industry. You’ll deploy and develop pipelines and platforms that organize and make disparate data meaningful. Here, you’ll work with and guide a multi-disciplinary team of analysts, data engineers, developers, and data consumers in a fast-paced, agile environment. You’ll use your experience in analytical exploration and data examination while you manage the assessment, design, building, and maintenance of scalable platforms for your clients.

The DoD is looking for individuals with exceptional software development, data engineering, or data science backgrounds who have done outstanding work utilizing tools such as Foundry, Spark, Python, Qlik, Tableau, and web development frameworks such as React. In short, we are seeking a “full-stack” data engineer who is passionate about building data applications from end to end. This includes data engineering back-ends to building interactive front-ends. For example, one of our offices is leading data analytics efforts of logistics data sets for the US Navy. You’ll work side by side with teammates in classified environments and own the development of analytics systems. You’ll use a variety of different tools and frameworks to turn sets of disparate data points into meaningful answers to advise our clients as they make informed decisions. Work with us to use data for good.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service.
