NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

NBCUniversal Advertising Products & Solutions (AP&S) is responsible for the product development and project management of NBCUniversal’s full advertising technology suite. From sales support to campaign execution, delivery, and billing, our division services both internal and external customers in support of NBCUniversal’s $7B+ annual advertising business. Together, we’re building the platform that powers the future of advertising at NBCU.

Our Data Collaboration Group, a core part of AP&S, powers the full advertiser lifecycle across insights, measurement, onboarding, activation, and optimization, utilizing various integration pathways including Data Clean Rooms and secure data shares.

Within the Data Collaboration Group, our Engineering & Operations team builds the automation and platform capabilities behind these workflows. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Automation Engineering to join the Engineering & Operations team. Reporting to the Director of Automation Engineering, this role will build AI-enabled automation systems and production-grade software that support NBCUniversal’s data collaboration ecosystem. 

The ideal candidate is a strong Python engineer who can design reliable systems, productize repeatable workflows, and build AI agents that help automate complex engineering and operational tasks across data platforms for audience activation, measurement, and reporting. 

Responsibilities:

AI Agent & Automation Engineering 

Design and build internal AI agents and automation workflows using technologies such as, Snowflake Cortex, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks, to support planning, tool use, retrieval, validation, and human-in-the-loop execution where appropriate. 

Develop reusable tools, APIs, and components that engineers can compose into new agentic workflows. 

Implement retrieval-augmented generation workflows, context management strategies, and prompt patterns that improve accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency. 

Agent Evaluation & Reliability 

Build evaluation harnesses, regression tests, and monitoring patterns for AI-agent behavior. 

Define and track metrics such as task completion, groundedness, response accuracy, latency, cost, and failure rate. 

Design guardrails and validation patterns to reduce hallucinations, unsafe outputs, and unreliable automation behavior. 

Partner with engineering and operations teams to move AI workflows from prototype to production-ready systems. 

Software Engineering & Platform Development 

Design, build, and maintain production-grade Python applications, libraries, and services. 

Champion object-oriented design principles, including encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance/composition, reusable interfaces, and clean separation of concerns to improve maintainability and extensibility. 

Champion software engineering best practices including modular design, automated testing, CI/CD, code reviews, observability, and documentation. 

Create reusable engineering patterns that reduce bespoke development effort and improve consistency across partner engagements. 

Collaborate with product, engineering, operations, and data platform teams to translate repeatable business needs into scalable technical solutions. 

Audience & Measurement Productization 

Build reusable Python libraries that support clean room capabilities across first-party audience workflows and core measurement use cases, including audience onboarding, ingestion, indexing, activation, campaign and impression delivery analysis, reach and frequency, attribution, and incrementality. 

Abstract complex analytical and data collaboration workflows into repeatable, self-service components for internal teams and external partners. 

Enable configurable feature deployment so new audience and measurement capabilities can be delivered quickly and consistently across partners. 

Technical Mentorship 

Mentor engineers through code reviews, technical design discussions, and operational best practices. 

Help establish engineering standards for AI-assisted workflows, agentic system design, reusable libraries, and production automation. 

Promote a culture of reliability, maintainability, and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field 

Software Engineering

5+ years of experience building production-grade software using Python, including libraries, services, testing, CI/CD, and code reviews 

AI / LLM Engineering

Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs, RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering, or frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar tools 

Agentic Systems / Automation 

Experience designing AI-enabled workflows, reasoning agents, tool-using agents, or complex automation systems 

Data Platforms 

3+ years of hands-on experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or similar technologies 

Systems Design 

Strong understanding of production system design, including observability, reliability, scalability, performance tuning, and operational support 

Preferred Qualifications 

Clean Room Knowledge 

Exposure to data clean room concepts or platforms such as Snowflake Clean Rooms, Databricks Clean Rooms, LiveRamp, Habu, or similar technologies 

Ad Tech / Measurement 

Experience with advertising technology, audience activation, campaign delivery, reach and frequency, attribution, incrementality, or reporting workflows 

Certifications 

Snowflake SnowPro Core Certification, Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate, or similar cloud/data platform certification 

Additional Requirements:

Full Remote:

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Storage Systems (Agent Infra)
jobs.description:
About Baseten

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

Storage decides how fast agent sandboxes start and how safely they share data. Agents need a filesystem that thousands of sandboxes mount at the same time, with strict isolation and the consistency agents need. Agent context is mostly small files, so the access patterns look very different from storage built for large files.

The Agent Infra team builds Agent Drive, the distributed filesystem that agent sandboxes mount over FUSE, and the storage underneath it. The work uses tiered caching, replication, content-addressed data, and Linux filesystem internals. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel, whose sandboxes and Agent Drive filesystem are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes.

We are building a cloud, not just using one, so storage is designed for many tenants from day one. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs.

If you care about page cache coherency, FUSE, replication protocols, and content-addressable storage, we'd love to talk.

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

Blaxel is joining Baseten to build the future of agentic infrastructure
Baseten Sandboxes documentation

Responsibilities

Design and implement core Agent Drive features: metadata replication, volume placement, garbage collection, and FUSE client behavior
Solve multi-attach correctness: cache coherency across many FUSE mounts of the same drive, dentry and inode invalidation, write ordering, and crash consistency
Optimize tail latency on read and write paths, including page cache strategy, writeback, prefetch, and metadata RPC batching
Build tenant isolation into the storage layer, including quota enforcement, blast-radius containment, and noisy-neighbor mitigation
Own the storage side of sandbox startup and resume performance
Build durable block storage for sandboxes alongside other Baseten storage teams
Build observability into every layer, drive storage incidents end to end, and turn each one into a permanent fix
Contribute upstream to the open-source storage projects we build on

Requirements

Strong systems programming background in Go, Rust, and/or C/C++, with comfort reading kernel code
Deep understanding of Linux filesystem and storage internals: VFS, page cache, dentry and inode caches, FUSE, the block I/O stack, fsync semantics, and crash consistency
Hands-on experience building distributed storage systems, content-addressable storage, or large-scale caching infrastructure
Experience profiling I/O, memory, and RPC bottlenecks and optimizing tail latency in production
Ability to debug correctness bugs that only show up under concurrency or partial failure
You move fast and like owning a problem end to end on a small team

NICE TO HAVE

Experience with a distributed filesystem or object store such as JuiceFS, CephFS, or S3-compatible storage, or contributions to those projects
Knowledge of consensus and replication protocols (Raft, leader leases, quorum reads)
Experience with snapshot, clone, and copy-on-write filesystem features
Experience operating multi-tenant storage with hard isolation requirements
Familiarity with Linux performance tooling such as eBPF, io_uring, perf, ftrace, and blktrace

Benefits

Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity
(U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents
Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)
Paid parental leave
Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot
(U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)
Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now
to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

Compensation Range: $160K - $330K

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title:
SDET Engineer

Location:
100% Remote (U.S.)

Position Type:
Full-time, Direct W2

Salary Range:
$90,000–$115,000 Annually

Experience Required:
7+ years

Sponsorship:

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SDET Engineer to bring strong software engineering practices to the discipline of test automation. In this role you will design, build, and continuously improve automation frameworks, write production-quality test code, and partner with development teams to embed quality engineering throughout the SDLC. The ideal candidate will combine strong programming skills with deep knowledge of testing strategy, including unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, and security testing in modern distributed systems. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline
Five or more years of experience as an SDET or in test-focused software engineering roles
Strong programming skills in at least one of Java, Python, JavaScript, or C#
Hands-on experience with at least one major UI automation framework (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright)
Solid experience automating REST and/or gRPC APIs
Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for test automation
Solid SQL skills and experience with database validation
Strong understanding of microservices, distributed systems, and modern web architectures
Excellent debugging, communication, and documentation skills
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with contract testing tools (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract)
Hands-on performance testing with JMeter, Gatling, k6, or Locust
Exposure to security testing tools (OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Snyk)
Familiarity with chaos engineering and resilience testing
ISTQB or equivalent QA certification

How to Apply

Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to hilda@bvteck.com. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer - New Grad
jobs.description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

About The Team

The Cloud Platform team runs the production inference service that serves SambaNova's models to customers on RDU accelerators. We handle deployment, monitoring, capacity planning, and incident response across regions in the United States, Asia, Europe, and Latin America.

About The Role

As a new grad Cloud Platform Engineer, you'll write automation and infrastructure code that keeps our inference service fast and available. You'll build monitoring and dashboards, manage Kubernetes clusters and Terraform modules, help stand up new regions, and join a shared on-call rotation once you're ramped up.

Responsibilities

Build monitoring, alerting, and dashboards in Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog
Manage cloud and on-prem infrastructure as code with Terraform and Ansible
Operate and maintain Kubernetes clusters that run our inference workloads
Help automate setup of AI infrastructure in new regions
Build CI/CD pipelines that deploy new model versions and service updates safely
Participate in a shared on-call rotation and incident response

Required Qualifications

B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field
Strong programming or scripting skills in Python, Go, or a similar language
Familiarity with Linux and command line tools
Coursework or project experience in distributed systems, networking, or cloud computing
Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, and HTTP
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
Experience with a public cloud provider such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure as code tools
Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus or Grafana
Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or ArgoCD

Preferred Qualifications

M.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field
Familiarity with model serving frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang
Internship experience in site reliability, DevOps, or backend infrastructure
Open source project ownership or contributions

Base Salary Range:

Base Pay Range

$1—$999,999 USD

Submission Guidelines

Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified.

EEO Policy

SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Benefits Summary For US-Based, Full-Time Employment Positions

SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
At Lhoist North America, our core values of Respect, Courage, and Integrity are more than words.
We respect people, encourage courageous innovation, and uphold integrity in everything we do. If these principles resonate with you, you may find your next great opportunity with us.

We believe our people make the difference. That’s why we invest in talent by offering meaningful opportunities to grow your skills, expand your knowledge, and pursue your interests. Our work environment prioritizes safety, fosters collaboration across teams, and embraces inclusion. Here, you’ll be challenged to grow, and you’ll be supported throughout your career journey. Join us and help shape the future of Lhoist North America.

POSITION SUMMARY:
The Automation Engineer is responsible for developing, maintaining and supporting process network and control systems for the Lhoist Apex Plant (mining and manufacturing) and similar systems across multiple Lhoist production sites. The Automation Engineer troubleshoots and solves on site instrumentation, process control and network system problems. The Automation Engineer provides technical support for data engineering and reporting, from data acquisition to storage and MES systems, and developing reporting tools.

Responsibilities & Expectations

Support Process Control and Automation Systems at plant sites.

Provide Automation support to LNA sites to ensure equipment safety, network security and operational efficiencies.
Work with other teams (Production, Maintenance, Engineering) to accurately understand problems and priorities and collaborate on solutions.
Troubleshoot and fix problems fast when instruments or control systems stop working to keep production running.
Improve processes by making changes to control settings or automation to save time, reduce waste, and improve quality.
Program and maintain systems like VMIs, PLCs, HMIs, Network Switches to control equipment and monitor performance.
Manage engineering data, including acquisition, cleaning, transformation, storage, security, data visualization and reporting.
Follow LNA standards and best practices for automation systems. Maintain up-to-date network architecture diagrams.
Support the implementation of plant process networks and automation upgrades and improvement projects.
Support and programming of Wonderware Intouch, Wonderware Historian, Rockwell PlantPAx and Factory Talk View SE systems at the plants.
Program, configure and setup, Allen Bradley 750 series drives, SMC Flex soft starts, E3 plus and E300 overloads.
Set up maintenance, calibration and interconnectivity of precision instruments, meters, analyzers, scanners and other control/monitoring devices.

Attributes

Advance Knowledge of Allen Bradley PLC software including PLC5, SLC 500, RSLogic 5000, GE PLC’s, and Modicon PLC’s.
Advance Knowledge of Ladder Logic, Function Block, Structured Text, Control Loop along with associated Digital and Analog I/O and all other PLC hardware.
Advance knowledge of HMI and SCADA systems including PlantPAx, Factory Talk View SE, Factory Talk Historian, Factory Talk Vision, Transaction Manager, ViewPoint, Wonderware Intouch, Wonderware Historian, and OSPI Vision.
Knowledge of OT Networking including different network topologies, fiber installation best practices, Cisco and AB Stratix switch configurations.
Knowledge of server-based systems using Server 2016, Server 2019 including experience with VMWare, Virtual servers, and VCenter.
Experience with ACAD, MSSQL and other Microsoft Application Software.
Industrial plant operations including mechanical, electrical and automation knowledge in low current and AC/DC systems.
Ability to analyze problems, learn how devices work, determine root causes, implement solutions safely, effectively and document work performed.
Interpret complex technical/electrical solutions into plain-English knowledgebase articles and how-to guides for local plant maintenance personnel.
Teamwork through communicating with other engineers, production and management personnel to develop an expert level of understanding.
Eagerness to self-develop and expand personal knowledge in automation systems such as emerging PLC technologies, Industrial Cybersecurity, Virtualization, Augmented Reality, Big Data Integration / Historian Systems and IIoT (Industry 4.0).

Physical Demands Include, But Are Not Limited To

Ability to travel 10% to sites within US/Canada
Will be working in both an office environment and in a mining process environment.
The employee will be required to perform the following actions (from time to time), standing, walking, balancing, stooping, kneeling, reaching, talking, seeing, hearing and sitting.
Must be physically able to perform work assigned and capable of accessing all plant locations, which could include heights, confined spaces, climbing ladders or stairs, and accessing tunnels.
Will require periodic travel to each of the regional locations as needed.
Must be physically able to perform work assigned.
Must respond to and address callouts/emergencies after regular business hours in the event of production down scenarios.
Tolerate working outside in adverse weather conditions as well as exposure to extreme high or low temperatures, noise, and dust.
Access all areas within a site which could include heights of 120 feet, confined spaces, climbing ladders or stairs, working on floating barges, and accessing tunnels.
Able to lift up to 50 pounds.

Required Experience

Minimum 5+ years’ industrial experience in process controls/automation system design, operation and maintenance.

Preferred Experience

In a mining or lime/cement/minerals manufacturing environment.

Required Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Automation Engineering or alternatively Electrical, Process Control, Mechatronic or Industrial Engineering degree with major or Master qualifications in Automation

Preferred Education

Bachelor of Science in Automation Engineering (B.S.E)

Lhoist North America is proud to offer a highly competitive compensation package designed to support your well-being and future.

Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, along with paid vacation and sick time. We also offer an attractive 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with a generous Employer Match as well as a Supplemental Contribution based on your Years of Service

jobs.title: Application Developer
jobs.description:
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.

Job Summary

IPAC at Caltech has an opening for an Associate Applications Developer to participate in the development of the data processing pipelines for the UVEX mission.

IPAC, part of the Physics, Math, and Astronomy Division at Caltech (www.caltech.edu), provides science operations, user support, data and archive services, and scientific vision to maximize discovery with observatories both in space and on the ground.

The Ultraviolet Explorer (UVEX) is targeted to launch in 2030 as NASA’s next Astrophysics Medium-Class Explorer mission. UVEX will undertake a synoptic survey of the entire sky in the near-UV and far-UV, probing the dynamic universe with a sensitivity more than 50 times better than GALEX. UVEX will also have a powerful broadband spectroscopic capability. UVEX will address fundamental questions from the Astro2020 Decadal Survey and study the evolution of low-metallicity, low-mass galaxies. UVEX time-domain surveys will probe the aftermaths of gravitational-wave-discovered compact object mergers, discover fast UV transients, and diagnose the early stages of explosive phenomena.

Essential Job Duties

As an Application Developer, you will work with the UVEX team to develop and test algorithms and write original production-quality code for pipeline processing and validation. You will also document your designs and software, and participate in meetings with the UVEX project.

Basic Qualifications

If you have the following in your background, then we want to hear about your interest in joining our team:

Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in a technical subject such as Astronomy, Physics, Math, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Sciences, or a related field.
3+ years of experience as a software developer using Python and C/C++. In many cases, this can include experience obtained concurrent with your academic work.
Familiarity with software configuration management principles and tools, source code version control (e.g., git/GitHub) and issue/bug tracking systems (e.g., Jira).

Preferred Qualifications

Beyond these basic qualifications, there are a set of skills and experiences which will add to your ability to contribute to the roles and responsibilities of an IPAC Applications Developer. The following might give you a head start here, but even if these do not describe you or your experience, we would still like to hear from you:

Advanced degree in Astronomy, Physics, Math, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Sciences, or a related field.
Experience working with scientific datasets and use cases.
Experience developing software for astronomical data analysis.
Experience with the Rubin/LSST Science Pipelines software stack.

Since UVEX is a distributed collaboration, it’s important that you have good written and verbal communication skills, and are comfortable working in a distributed development environment.

Required Documents

Resume
Short Cover Letter (optional)

Deadline and Start Date

Applications received by November 17, 2026 will receive full consideration. The position is intended to start in 2026.

This is an on-site position at the Caltech campus in Pasadena, California. Remote workdays are typically allowed 1-2 days per week.

Life at IPAC and Caltech

Caltech is an award-winning workplace and one of the best places to work in the greater Los Angeles area. We offer an exciting and dynamic work environment, career development opportunities, competitive pay programs, great benefits, and the opportunity to participate in many campus programs and activities.

People choose to work at IPAC for many reasons, and the casual, employee-centric culture often leads to fulfilling, long-term careers and lasting relationships. We seek the best and brightest talent to join our workforce and become members of our community.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Networking (Agent Infra)
jobs.description:
About Baseten

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

Every agent on Baseten Sandboxes runs in its own microVM. Agents call models, reach tools and APIs, expose services, and more and more often talk to each other. Networking built into today's cloud providers was not designed for very large numbers of isolated machines that suspend, resume, and exchange data constantly.

The Agent Infra team builds its own networking stack for sandboxes, designed from the start for that scale. It runs in user space, with VPP (FD.io) as its main data plane technology, and is built from virtualized network functions (VNF/NFV): carrier-grade, low-latency packet processing designed for very large numbers of agents. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel, whose sandboxes, storage, and networking are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes.

You'll build multi-tenant virtual private networking that connects each customer's agents and services privately and securely, using modern overlay technologies.

We are building a cloud, not just using one. We want engineers who expose the network as a programmable API and write the code, not operators who push router and switch configuration. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs.

This role is separate from Baseten's GPU-to-GPU networking. Here you'll own how sandboxes connect to each other, to Baseten services, to customer networks, and to the internet.

If you've built user-space data planes, virtualized network functions, or multi-tenant cloud networking and want to design one for agents, we'd love to talk.

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

Blaxel is joining Baseten to build the future of agentic infrastructure
Securing the open frontier with NVIDIA OpenShell and Blaxel sandboxes
Baseten Sandboxes documentation

Responsibilities

Design and build the user-space, VPP-based data plane that connects microVM sandboxes to each other, to Baseten services, and to the internet
Build multi-tenant virtual private networking and overlays (for example EVPN, GENEVE, VXLAN) across regions
Expose the network as a programmable API that the rest of the platform calls
Cut latency and raise connection scale for agent-to-agent and agent-to-service traffic
Build routing that sends each request to the nearest region and keeps connections working as sandboxes suspend and resume
Build secure ingress and egress for sandboxes, including firewalling, static egress IPs, and custom domains with managed TLS
Build L7 proxies for request inspection, filtering, secret injection, and auditing
Own per-sandbox addressing, including IPv6, and network isolation between tenants
Build observability for the packet path across guest, host, and network, and debug production issues end to end
Work closely with the compute, storage, GPU infrastructure, and datacenter teams

Requirements

Experience with user-space packet processing (DPDK, VPP, or similar) or virtualized network functions (VNF/NFV)
Experience building multi-tenant networking in production (VXLAN, GENEVE, VRF)
Experience building a software-defined network, overlay network, or packet-processing data plane in production
You write production code: strong systems programming in Rust, Go, and/or C/C++. Network architects are welcome if they build, not only configure
Experience building cloud networking as the provider, not only consuming a cloud provider's network
Solid grounding in TCP/IP and routing
Experience building or operating proxies, load balancers, or L4/L7 gateways at scale
Experience debugging latency and throughput problems with packet captures, tracing, and profiling
You move fast and like owning a problem end to end on a small team

NICE TO HAVE

Experience with VPP / FD.io, our main networking technology
Experience with GENEVE or VXLAN overlays and EVPN
Linux kernel networking: eBPF/XDP, netfilter or nftables, network namespaces
Familiarity with virtual machine networking: virtio-net, vhost, TAP devices, or networking for Firecracker or Cloud Hypervisor
Experience running IPv6 at scale
Background in telecom user-plane or 5G core networking, or in low-latency trading networks
Experience with multi-region traffic routing, anycast, or BGP
Experience with TLS termination, DNS, and egress security controls

Benefits

Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity
(U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents
Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)
Paid parental leave
Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot
(U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)
Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now
to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

Ampere is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and support low-level platform firmware for Armv9-based systems. In this role, you will focus on Trusted Firmware-A (TF-A) and related platform software, working at the intersection of hardware and software to enable secure, reliable, high-performance compute platforms.

You will collaborate closely with hardware design, validation, and software engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle—from pre-silicon development on models, emulation, and FPGA platforms through post-silicon bring-up, validation, release, and customer support. jobs.description:
We are looking for the best

About Us

42dot is a mobility AI company committed to solving mobility challenges with software and AI. As the Global Software Center of Hyundai Motor Group, 42dot pioneers the future of mobility by advancing the development of software-defined vehicles.

We develop safety-first, user-centric software-defined vehicle technologies that deliver the latest performance through continuous updates like smartphones. By advancing software and AI technology, 42dot envisions a world where everything is connected and moves autonomously through a self-managing urban transportation operating system.

About The Role

Develop driving and physical AI foundation models. Support Aria VLA model development.

Responsibilities

Data Curation & Pretraining: Design and manage massive, multi-terabyte datasets, including data scraping, filtering, deduplication, tokenization, and synthetic data generation.
Distributed Model Training: Scale training across massive GPU/TPU clusters using parallel processing, custom data loaders, and framework optimization (PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow).
Post-Training & Alignment: Implement instruction tuning, Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), or direct preference optimization to align models with safety and behavior goals.
Inference & Optimization: Compress and optimize models (quantization, pruning, speculative decoding) to run at low latency on cloud infrastructure or edge hardware like smartphones and robotics.
Evaluation & Guardrails: Build benchmarking harnesses, hallucination checkers, and red-teaming pipelines to test model accuracy and safety.

Qualifications

Languages: Python, C++, and Golang (for high-throughput systems).
Frameworks: PyTorch, JAX, Hugging Face ecosystem, vLLM.
Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Docker, multi-node distributed training (Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed), and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
Math & Theory: Linear algebra, calculus, probability, statistics, and deep learning architectures (Transformers, diffusion models).

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

We are excited to announce that we are looking for a talented individual to join our team as a Configure, Price Quote (CPQ) Knowledge Engineer (KE) & Application Development Intern. In this role, the candidate will be assisting with the development and maintenance of Product Configuration applications (e.g., Logik.AI), ensuring seamless integration with our existing systems, and optimizing the configuration and pricing processes. We are seeking someone with strong technical skills, a keen eye for detail, and a passion for innovation. If you are looking for an opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, we would love to hear from you!

Knowledge Engineers (KEs) collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, R&D, Order Fulfillment, and Order Management to design ERP product structures and configurations for new product/option introductions with selectable features and pricing. KEs are responsible for automating the generation of accurate product quotes and orders for customers quickly and efficiently, improving quote and sales efficiency. KEs ensure that product configuration complexity is hidden using logical rules to display only relevant product selections and feature information in compliance with product specifications and Keysight Standards, guiding Keysight customers, sales representatives, and field engineers through product selection and configuration.

In the KE Team we also develop applied solutions for streamlining & modernizing digitized processes within Technology Order Fulfillment (TOF), replacing manual processes with innovative informatics and software solutions to increase configuration and operations productivity.

Primary Responsibilities:

Design new ways to optimize and improve the product quote-to-order process and experience.
Reduce new product introduction time to market through innovative product structure, configuration and related processes or solutions.
Deliver and maintain Technology Order Fulfillment (TOF) software solutions for configuration and operations which complement Keysight Enterprise Solutions.
Drive increased efficiency and productivity.
Modernize existing processes and digital assets with a focus on reducing or replacing manual work and eliminating waste.

Pursuing a BS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent degree

Your hiring manager will discuss this role's specific work requirements with you during the hiring process. All work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need.

Provides contributions in the design, coding, testing, support and debugging of new software or enhancements to existing software.

Participate in DevOps principals practiced by the engineering organization.
Collaborates with other Engineers, Technical Leads, Architects, QA, Performance Testers, Scrum Masters, and Product Owners.
Uses technical knowledge, creativity and company practices and priorities to obtain solutions to complex problems.
Interfaces with senior management to provide and obtain information and to build consensus regarding project direction.
Escalate issues to senior management early, before they create significant impact to a project/release.
Review and approve all mid-level design documentation.
Ensure that detail design documentation is competed, reviewed, and approved, as required.
Conduct or participate in code review sessions to ensure quality and performance.
Participate and contribute to innovation workshops and hackathons

Review security testing reports/results and remediate potential vulnerabilities in a timely manner.
Serves as a mentor to lower level developers.
Interacts directly with business clients.

The Qualifications We’re Looking For

1+ years of applicable experience and a bachelor’s degree in technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of experience and education.
Knowledge of all phases of software development including design, coding, testing, debugging, implementation, and support
Experience writing and reviewing software design specifications in an object-oriented development environment

Effective communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences

Ability to be a technical authority and work with other team members
Knowledge of standard change management tools and processes
Ability to work in a team environment
Hands on technical experience

Software Engineer to join our Owners & Sellers team. ●    Develop and Maintain: Own systems and evolutions for key parts of the Owners & Sellers platform, defining clear boundaries, contracts, and data models between services. Participate in and lead architectural discussions, contributing to technical design documents and implementation proposals.
●     Full-Stack Excellence: Maintain and improve the stability, readability, and scalability of the codebase, ensuring best practices across backend services and frontend architecture using React and Next.js.

new_jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Nuro believes self-driving vehicles are the most immediate and profound opportunity for AI to drive positive change in the physical world. Safer streets, more time for what matters, and easier access to the world around us, that’s why we’re building a universal autonomy platform: self-driving for all roads and all rides.

Founded in 2016, Nuro is a physical AI company developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology for a wide range of vehicles, use cases, and markets. Powered by the Nuro Driver™, our universal autonomy platform enables the global mobility ecosystem to deploy autonomy at scale, from robotaxis and logistics fleets to personal vehicles.

With years of real-world deployment experience and a flexible, partner-led business model, Nuro is working toward a future where millions of autonomous vehicles powered by our technology help make everyday life safer, easier, and more connected.

Nuro has raised over $2B in capital from Uber, NVIDIA, Google, Softbank, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, and other leading investors.

About The Role

Nuro operates real self-driving vehicles on public roads today — not a research platform, not ADAS. The Embedded Software Engineering team builds the software for the safety-critical embedded controllers that connect the Nuro Driver™ to the vehicle: the devices that command steering, braking, and propulsion, alongside other vehicle actuators, distribute and monitor power, monitor vehicle motion, and bring the vehicle to a safe state when something goes wrong.

As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will work across the full stack of multicore automotive microcontrollers from RTOS, drivers, and scheduler up through middleware and application components that talk to the vehicle, and help extend that stack as our hardware evolves. You will bring the Nuro Driver™ up on new vehicle platforms alongside OEM and supplier engineers, and see your code drive real vehicles on public roads. We're hiring across levels, from engineers with a couple years of embedded experience to those who've shipped a production automotive launch.

About The Work

Design, implement and test embedded C software for safety-critical multicore automotive microcontrollers, spanning base software such as RTOS, device drivers, scheduling and bootloader, middleware such as inter-component messaging and end-to-end protection, and application components such as actuator interface, body controls, power management and fault management.
Integrate the Nuro Driver™ with new vehicle platforms: define and implement CAN and Ethernet interfaces with OEM ECUs, adapt actuator and body-control interfaces, and validate them on bench and in vehicle.
Take part in hands-on device and vehicle bring-up, prototyping and debugging on multiple vehicle platforms, from first power-on to autonomous driving.
Build and maintain the team's verification infrastructure: unit tests, hardware-in-the-loop benches and vehicle test procedures.
Work within an ISO 26262 development process: define software requirements from system safety requirements, then implement and verify them with full traceability.
Collaborate daily with systems, safety, hardware, controls and autonomy engineers, and with OEM and supplier partners, from definition through verification.

About You

B.S. or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field.
2+ years of industry experience developing embedded software in C, including work on a real-time operating system.
Solid computer science fundamentals: data structures, concurrency and algorithm design.
Working knowledge of microcontroller internals and peripherals, with depth in at least one of device driver development, CAN or automotive Ethernet, bootloaders and software update, embedded security, or vehicle-level integration and test.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, clear written and spoken communication, and a track record of working well with engineers from other disciplines.
Comfortable at the bench with debug probes, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and CAN tools. You enjoy finding out why hardware and software disagree.

Bonus Points

3+ years of embedded development in the automotive or autonomous vehicle industry, including a production launch.
Hands-on functional safety experience with ISO 26262, or safety-critical development in another regulated industry such as DO-178C or IEC 62304.
Experience with Infineon AURIX TC3xx, SafeRTOS or FreeRTOS, or AUTOSAR Classic base software such as MCAL and communication stacks.
Vehicle network integration experience: DBC and ARXML, UDS diagnostics, E2E protection, time synchronization.
Knowledge of vehicle functions, vehicle dynamics or control theory.

At Nuro, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. For this position, the reasonably expected base pay range is between $145,830 and $219,000 for the level at which this job has been scoped. Your base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, equity, and a competitive benefits package.

At Nuro, we celebrate differences and are committed to a diverse workplace that fosters inclusion and psychological safety for all employees. Nuro is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and expressly prohibits any form of workplace discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

team works directly with clients and partners to ensure that every technical aspect of our product—installation, configuration, and customization—is delivered smoothly and at the highest standard. You will guide clients through complex integration and performance management strategies, leveraging your deep technical expertise in SQL, NoSQL, Cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ). While you will advise on the installation and configuration of our platform, you will also apply your hands-on engineering skills to design and implement custom Java interfaces, web service integrations, and bespoke extensions for our Fraud Analysis platform. Working alongside Data Scientists, Project Managers, and Fraud Analysts, you will translate client challenges into robust, scalable technical requirements and remain actively involved in executing those requirements when specialized development is required.

Your Day To Day

Consult with clients to define technical requirements and architectural approaches for custom integrations.
Develop high-quality, testable Java code for custom extensions and complex integrations when standard configurations do not meet specific client needs.
Diagnose complex performance and integration challenges, providing expert guidance and code-level solutions to ensure system stability.
Act as a strategic bridge between client business goals and technical execution, translating needs into efficient, scalable software solutions.
Contribute to and advocate for engineering best practices, ensuring that custom work remains maintainable and aligned with the core product roadmap.
Mentor, coach, and inspire other team members, helping foster best practices in software development and technical consulting.
Work with Agile principles to regularly deliver quality products.
Provide Second Tier support for live clients.

You Have & You Know-how

A Bachelor of Science and/or a Master of Science in Computer Science, a degree in a comparable field, or equivalent work experience;
3 years of work experience in Java software development;
Thread and JVM Memory Management in high-performance systems;
Client engagement experience and ability to act as a consultant to our clients;
Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written;
Experience with Zookeeper, RabbitMQ, Cassandra, Ansible, Docker, and databases (nice to have).

The Customer Success
Team is responsible for delivering our product to our clients. This includes configuration, solution development, and risk strategy to enable them to address their pain points. We grow at a fast clip and believe no challenge is too big or too small. Therefore, we have an open environment that encourages us to lean in, try new things, and discover our potential. Join us!

About Activate Care:

At Activate Care, we're on a mission to improve health equity and drive better health outcomes across the country. Our Care Link platform enables healthcare and community organizations to coordinate care for populations challenged with health-related social needs (HRSN). Path Assist is our tech-enabled community health worker program for HRSN that uses an evidence-based, structured intervention to help individuals build confidence managing their health and accessing the resources they need. Our goal is simple: increase health confidence, improve self-efficacy, and reduce inappropriate healthcare spending.

About the Role:

Our platform helps healthcare providers and community organizations coordinate care for individuals facing complex medical and social challenges. The systems we build support real-time collaboration across health records, referral networks, and community services.

As a Software Engineer at Activate Care, you will help design and build the tools that power this coordination. You will work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver high-quality software that directly supports organizations improving outcomes for vulnerable populations.

You'll contribute across the full development lifecycle—from designing solutions and writing production code to improving system quality and participating in technical discussions within your team.

Responsibilities:

Implement well-specified features with guidance from senior engineers
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code that supports system reliability and scalability
Contribute to responsive web applications and progressive web apps
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and team ceremonies
Write and maintain automated tests to ensure system reliability
Collaborate with product and design teams to deliver user-focused solutions
Document code, specifications, and workflows for clarity and reusability
Learn and apply prompt engineering, AI-assisted dev tools, and automation frameworks to accelerate productivity

Requirements

Qualifications & Skills:

Must Have:

Minimum of a High School Diploma with an equivalent of 4+ years of Software Engineering experience, or a Bachelor's Degree in a related field
3+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer, healthcare experience is preferred
Experience working effectively within Agile/Scrum teams
Advanced ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non technical stakeholders
Willingness, and ability to learn new technologies, adapt to feedback and continuously improve technical skills

Core Technical Skills

Experience building applications using Ruby on Rails, Ruby Sinatra, or Node JS /Fastify
Frontend development experience with React, Svelte and modern JavaScript
Experience building scalable responsive web applications and progressive web apps using HTML/CSS
Experience with Native web applications is a plus

Experience developing and integrating RESTful APIs and web services
Familiarity with relational or document databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or EdgeDB
Experience with background job processing systems such as ActiveJob, Sidekiq, or Resque

Productivity & AI-Enhanced Development

Experience using Cursor, MCP agents, LLMs, or Ollama
Strong understanding of prompt engineering concepts
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins or CircleCI
Familiarity with development automation and workflow optimization

Software Engineering Principles

Strong understanding of separation of concerns, code quality, and maintainable architecture
Experience designing and implementing well-tested features
Familiarity with multiple quality domains such as functionality, performance, and reliability
Experience with testing frameworks such as Cypress, MiniTest, or other automated testing approaches
Experience working with Git workflows, pull requests, and collaborative development practices

Nice to Have:

Experience maintaining Ruby on Rails applications in production environments
Experience maintaining PWA's and SPA applications
Experience working with AWS or other cloud platforms
Familiarity with containerization tools such as Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes/Helm
Knowledge of secure coding practices (OWASP, Brakeman) and handling sensitive healthcare data (HIPAA awareness)
Prior experience working on healthcare platforms or workflow automation systems

Diversity & Inclusion:

At Activate Care, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation, and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military, and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Ally and Your Career

Ally Financial only succeeds when its people do - and that’s more than some cliché people put on job postings. We love this stuff! We see our people as, well, people - with interests, families, friends, dreams, and causes that are all important to them. Our focus is on the health and safety of our teammates as well as work-life balance and diversity and inclusion. From generous benefits to a variety of employee resource groups, we strive to build paths that encourage employees to stretch themselves professionally. We want to help you grow, develop, and learn new things. You’re constantly evolving, so shouldn’t your opportunities be, too?

Work Schedule:
Ally designates roles as (1) fully on-site, (2) hybrid, or (3) fully remote. Hybrid roles are generally expected to be in the office a certain number of days per week as indicated by your manager. Your hiring manager will discuss this role's specific work requirements with you during the hiring process. All work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Software Engineer at Ally, you will design, build, test, and support software that powers critical customer and business experiences. You will own meaningful technical solutions from design through production, work independently within squad priorities, and mentor less-experienced engineers.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who balances near-term delivery with quality, security, reliability, and long-term technical health. We value the ability to solve problems, learn new technologies, and use AI development tools effectively.

At Ally, you will solve meaningful engineering problems at enterprise scale while staying close to the code. You will work across modern and established platforms, use advanced AI-assisted development tools, and help shape how our technology evolves.

The Work Itself

Design, develop, test, deploy, and support production software.
Own features and technical solutions from design through implementation and support.
Write and review code using traditional, automated, and AI-assisted development approaches.
Collaborate with Product, Architecture, SRE, Cybersecurity, Risk, and partner engineering teams.
Improve software quality, reliability, maintainability, and developer productivity.
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance.

Minimum Qualifications

The Qualifications We're Looking For

3+ years of relevant experience
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

Professional experience building and supporting production software in a complex environment.
Strong engineering fundamentals with depth in at least one programming language or technology domain.
Ability to independently drive solutions, raise risks, and seek alignment when needed.
Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.
A production mindset that considers security, reliability, observability, maintainability, and customer impact.

Core Technologies

Experience with some of the following: Python, Java, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, React Native, Spring, REST APIs, automated testing, CI/CD, Git, and AWS or Azure.

How We'll Have Your Back

Ally's compensation program offers market-competitive base pay and pay-for-performance incentives (bonuses) based on achieving personal and company goals. Our Total Rewards program includes industry-leading compensation and benefits plus additional incentives that are designed to meet your needs and those of your family so you can get the most out of your career and your life, including:

Time Away:
Program starts at 20 paid time off days in addition to 11 paid holidays and 8 hours of volunteer time off yearly (time off days are prorated based on start date and program varies based on full or part-time status and management level).

Planning for the Future:
plan for the near and long term with an industry-leading 401K retirement savings plan with matching and company contributions, student loan pay downs and 529 educational save up assistance programs, tuition reimbursement, employee stock purchase plan, and financial learning center and financial coach access.

Supporting your Health & Well-being:
flexible health and insurance options including medical, dental and vision, employee, spouse and child life insurance, short- and long-term disability, pre-tax Health Savings Account with employer contributions, Healthcare FSA, critical illness, accident & hospital indemnity insurance, and a total well-being program that helps you and your family stay on track physically, socially, emotionally, and financially.

Building a Family:
adoption, surrogacy and fertility assistance as well as paid parental and caregiver leave, Dependent Day Care FSA back-up child and adult/elder care days and childcare discounts.

Work-Life Integration:
other benefits including Mentally Fit Employee Assistance Program, subsidized and discounted Weight Watchers® program and other employee discount programs.

Other Compensations:
depending on the role for which you are considered, you may be eligible for travel allowances, relocation assistance, a signing bonus and/or equity.

To view more detailed information about Ally’s Total Rewards, please visit this link: https://www.ally.com/content/dam/pdf/corporate/ally-total-rewards-snapshot.pdf

Who We Are

Ally Financial is a customer-centric, leading digital financial services company with passionate customer service and innovative financial solutions. We are relentlessly focused on "Doing it Right" and being a trusted financial-services provider to our consumer, commercial, and corporate customers. For more information, visit www.ally.com.

About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About The Team

The Growth Engineering team at Mixpanel is responsible for increasing user activation and driving self-serve revenue. We work closely with Product, Design, and Marketing to grow the funnel of customers landing on our platform, implementing Mixpanel, and seeing value fast. We move fast, experiment constantly, and measure everything.

Within growth: this role is for the Top of Funnel Pod, a small crew specifically targeting user acquisition and activation. Some examples of what we’ve shipped lately:

Agentic onboarding
Experiment: Home page new feature product setup nudges
Experiment: MCP connection

About The Role

As a Software Engineer on the Growth team, you will build and optimize the experiences that drive user acquisition, activation, and conversion at Mixpanel. A key focus of this role is web experimentation — you'll design, implement, and analyze experiments across our product onboarding flows and other surface areas to improve key growth metrics. You'll work across the full stack, from frontend UI changes to backend data pipelines, and collaborate with Product and Design to turn experiment insights into product improvements. This is a high-impact role where your work directly influences Mixpanel's top-of-funnel growth and self-serve revenue.

Responsibilities

Design, build, and analyze experiments across Mixpanel's product and onboarding flows to optimize acquisition and activation metrics
Partner with Product and Design to identify high-impact experiment hypotheses grounded in data and user research
Instrument tracking and build dashboards (in Mixpanel!) to measure experiment outcomes and inform iteration
Build and improve onboarding experiences that drive down time to value, and increase activation rates for new Mixpanel users
Participate in team on-call rotation to improve our systems and keep them healthy

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

At least 2 years of full-stack software engineering experience
Excellent debugging and technical investigation skills
Comfort using modern AI coding tools
Experience running growth experimentation
Strong technical communication, ideally with experience collaborating in an asynchronous remote environment
Ability to move fast and iterate — you take ownership of problems and focus on delivering value to users
A data-driven mindset

Bonus Points For

Interest in leveraging AI/GenAI to accelerate experimentation workflows
Prior experience on a growth engineering team or in a growth-focused role
React / TypeScript experience
Django / Python experience
Experience with experimentation platforms (e.g. Mixpanel, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly, Statsig, or similar)

Benefits And Perks

Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care
Mental Wellness Benefit
Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays
Enhanced Parental Leave
Volunteer Time Off
Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break
please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.
Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.
One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.
Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.
Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.
Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Job Description

Join a dynamic team focused on automating and streamlining the Post-Test Analysis (PTA) pipeline for the THAAD Ground Station Team. This role aims to reduce manual analyst overhead, accelerate test validation, and generate key qualification deliverables.

Responsibilities

Architect and implement core automated log parsing, data reduction models, tool integrations, and reporting engines.
Develop, test, and maintain automated scripts, unit tests, and continuous build processes.
Engage in Agile Integration & Execution, managing features via prioritized backlogs with bi-monthly progress meetings and live working code demos.
Develop modular Python libraries and interactive Jupyter Notebook environments for hands-off test-step validation, log ingestion, parsing, error extraction, event sequencing, and time-series log alignment.
Leverage core Python data science libraries to process raw log streams, execute data reduction, and align sensor and target trajectory data in time and space.
Evaluate and integrate the Python-based SLAP tool for visual log parsing, timeline inspection, and diagnostic plotting.
Automate the compilation of telemetry, performance metrics, plots, and 3D mission reconstruction animations into standardized reports.
Utilize Test-Driven Development with unit/integration test suites, Docker containerization, and Git repository management.

Advanced Python programming and modular library development.
Expertise in the Core Python Data Science Stack (pandas, numpy, scipy, scikit-learn) for high-dimensional data reduction and spatio-temporal telemetry alignment.
Integration of graphical utilities such as SLAP, Plotly, Dash, and Matplotlib.
Design and integration of relational (SQL) and document-oriented (NoSQL) databases.
Experience with automated report generation and 3D mission reconstruction visualization tools.
Proficiency in constructing interactive Jupyter Notebook workflows.
Version control and DevOps practices using Git and Docker containerization.
Experience with Test-Driven Development, including writing unit and integration testing suites.
Strong technical writing skills to support customer deliverables.

Experience in creating custom dashboards and visual utilities.
Familiarity with automated data reduction and input streamlining processes.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

About Fab2

The fab2 team can build anything. We design all the hardware and software needed to make chips and we make the fabs, tools, and components ourselves.

We're looking for exceptional, hands-on people who can iterate to the limits of what's possible.

fab2 was founded by Sam Zeloof and Jim Keller. Sam is best known for making chips in his garage, and Jim has been a leader in the semiconductor industry for the past 40 years.

About The Team

The tool software group builds Linux control software and microcontroller firmware for fab2’s in-house semiconductor manufacturing equipment. This includes software for sensing, real-time microcontroller firmware, closed loop controls, sequencing, recipe execution, interlocks, operator user interfaces, and diagnostics.

About The Role

You will build computer vision software for lithography and metrology on semiconductor manufacturing equipment. This includes modeling optical systems and developing nanometer-scale alignment (fiducials, calibration methods) through iteration on real hardware. You will also develop vision systems for wafer-handling and process automation equipment. Additionally, you will work on post-lithography metrology, including defect detection and optical proximity correction (OPC) modeling.

You will work closely with full-stack, mechanical, electrical, optical, and process engineers on cross-functional problems.

We are open to a range of experience levels, from early-career to experienced engineers. The most important attribute is a strong mathematical and programming background and the ability to experiment and learn new things.

Responsibilities

Develop classical computer vision algorithms for inspection, measurement/metrology, alignment, positioning, defect detection, and camera calibration.
Build systems that extract reliable measurements and process information from images, including dimensions, feature boundaries, and manufacturing variation.
Develop image registration, camera calibration, and pose estimation capabilities for precision equipment and optical systems.
Apply spatial-domain and frequency-domain image processing techniques to solve scientific and industrial vision problems.
Integrate computer vision systems with cameras, motion systems, robotics, and other electromechanical equipment.
Turn experimental approaches into reliable production software, including testing, validation, performance optimization, and failure handling.
Partner with software, mechanical, electrical, optical, and process engineers to develop new manufacturing and metrology tools.

Required Experience

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong foundation in classical computer vision and image processing.
Experience with techniques such as image registration, feature detection, camera calibration, geometric transformations, pose estimation, or image filtering.
Experience analyzing images in both the spatial and frequency domains.
Understanding of how optics, illumination, sensors, noise, and resolution affect image quality and computer vision performance.
Experience developing computer vision software using Python, C++, OpenCV, or similar tools.
Ability to design experiments, compare technical approaches, and characterize algorithm accuracy and repeatability.
Ability to take computer vision work beyond a prototype and deploy it as maintainable, reliable software.

Nice-to-have

Experience with semiconductor equipment, metrology, manufacturing inspection, microscopy, scientific instrumentation, or industrial automation.
Experience characterizing optical systems using metrics such as resolution, MTF, PSF, etc.
An understanding of optical inaccuracies: chromatic/spherical aberrations, astigmatism, etc.
Experience with precision alignment, motion systems, robotics, or sensor fusion.
Experience working with scientific or industrial cameras.
Research experience, publications, or a strong computer vision project portfolio.

We’re an early-stage hardware startup with solid funding, world-class advisors, and labs/offices in Austin, TX, Lockhart, TX, and San Francisco, CA.

Description

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. Your greatest work is ahead!

Leidos’ Defense Sensors - Sensor Research and Analysis Division is seeking a Software Developer
to join our team. The division performs radar design, hardware builds, algorithm development, software development, HWIL testing and analysis across a variety of both research and development and operational tasks.

The candidate selected for this role will primarily support the design, implementation, and optimization of real-time software powering RF seeker capabilities and signal-processing pipelines. The selected candidate will maintain a familiarity with the fielded systems our division supports, investigate cutting-edge RF seeker technologies, and develop studies which educate our customers on seeker technology advancements. These studies will consist of provisional MATLAB modeling, closed-loop simulation, and validation on radar hardware. The selected candidate will work closely with algorithm development engineers to transition prototype algorithms (such as MATLAB/Python models) into robust, maintainable, high-performance software architectures (modern C++) targeted for real-time and embedded environments. You will also participate in closed-loop simulations, HWIL integration, and system validation on radar hardware. The candidate will present progress and findings of these studies to government and prime contractor stakeholders and will collaborate with the rest of the division on radar development and testing activities.

If this sounds like the kind of environment where you can thrive, keep reading!

Leidos Defense Systems Sector
provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions. To explore and learn more, click here!

Are you ready to make an impact? Share your resume with us today!

Relevant Experience Areas

RF Seeker CONOPS – Concepts of operations and decisions to close the kill chain with an RF seeker in various use cases and environments.
RF Seeker Mode Logic – Waveform, algorithm, and guidance methods associated with distinct stages of an RF Seeker flight, and transitioning between those stages.
Signal Processing – Waveform design, matched filtering, detections processing, clutter rejection, target feature extraction
Electronic Warfare – Analysis of radio signal countermeasures and protections against countermeasures
Simulation Development – Designing architecture, resource management, interface, and feature models of radar and seeker simulations
Modeling & Analysis – Setup, test, analyze, and evaluate radar or communications algorithms in software
Software Development – Experience in high performance computing languages such as C++
Calibration – Far-field and/or near-field calibration techniques for radar systems
Tracking – Design and analysis of Kalman filters, IMMs, detection to track association varieties
Radar Resource Management – Scheduling techniques for optimized commands between radar subsystems
RF Test Equipment – Experience with RF troubleshooting equipment such as Vector Network Analyzers, oscilloscopes, and signal generators

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering or related technical field from an ABET-accredited institution plus 2+ years of experience in one or more listed experience areas, or a relevant MS degree with exposure to one or more listed experience areas.
Must have excellent math skills and/or possess and show good fundamentals in one or more of the following:
Signals and systems
Digital signal processing
Tracking algorithms
Electromagnetics

Should be able to apply one or more of the above skills to the areas of radar modeling & simulation, antenna array theory, digital signal processing, tracking, algorithm development, and field testing of sensor systems.
Experience working with MATLAB, Python, or similar scientific-based programming tools to implement math or scienced based phenomenology related to linear systems, digital signal processing, tracking, or electromagnetics is required.
Experience with developing component/subsystem/system acceptance/verification test plans and reports.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a strong technical background.
A positive, proactive attitude and enthusiasm for learning, collaborating, and tackling challenging engineering problems.
Must be a resident of the North Alabama area or willing to relocate to the Huntsville - North Alabama, AL area. This is NOT a remote or work-from-home position.
Must be a US Citizen and possess (and be able to maintain) a Final Secret Clearance or meet the eligibility to obtain (and maintain) a Secret Clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated proficiency in several of the listed experience areas
Highly organized, demonstrating the ability to work independently at times due to fast-paced and highly productive work environment
Ability to create design documentation, requirements specifications, and other technical documentation
Demonstrated experience in understanding, evaluating, and implementing published scientific literature from sources such as IEEE.
Relevant publications in listed experience areas

At Ally, you get a startup feel, with the benefits of a company that has worked out the kinks and is fulfilling its purpose. We are always evolving, and we see that as a good thing.
